name: Dry food
summary: Moving air matters as much as heat. A solar dryer is a black box under glass that sends warm air up through screened trays; a small 12V fan on a solar panel speeds it up and runs only when the sun is out. On a sunny day, a parked car with the windows cracked works in a pinch.

parts.why: Moves damp air out and speeds drying
A black absorber plate heats the air
Runs the fan directly, with no battery
Low, gentle heat for drying in cloudy weather
Clear covers where glass is scarce
Mesh and cloth to keep insects off

tips: Slice food thin and even, about 5 mm, so it dries before it spoils.
Heat meat to 71°C before or after drying to kill germs.
Keep flies off with fine mesh. They lay eggs on drying food.
Food is dry when it’s leathery or snaps, with no moist spots. Store it sealed.
